Me Too Honey, Me Too. #MeToo 

I wish someone actually did something tangible and stopped that man from harassing, abusing and assaulting other girls.
Everyday, I beat myself up because I feel like I failed those girls and he just went on with his life as if nothing happened.

So, as for me, my feminism is bitter and angry and it is centered in women.
Because I've seen everyday, how SGBV and femicide is ravaging our lives.
I don't why I shouldn't be bitter and angry. #MeToo #RIPHinyUmoren
